messages:
Nina: deploy-bot flagged staging promo BLOCKED — artifact fetch errors + e2e timeouts on canary.

deploy-bot: PROMO_BLOCK staging canary v2026.5.20 -> v2026.5.21
checks: artifact-fetch: FAILED (tarball checksum mismatch x2, 404 on blob x1)
e2e-suite: 8/12 passed (timeouts during app-start)
logs: https://ci.internal/4412360000/canary/3

Owen: artifact 404 + tarball checksum mismatch looks like cache eviction from our ci-cache layer. infra-bot, seen anything in cache-pruner?

infra-bot: CACHE_METRICS: cache-pruner completed sweep at 02:14 UTC. Evicted items: 12. Eviction policy: LRU+TTL. S3 backend transient 503s reported 02:12-02:18 UTC in eu-west-1.

Nina: change window closes in 40m. Product expects this cut. Options: A) pin to last-good image v2026.5.20; B) rebuild artifacts and rerun canary (risk: may exceed window); C) delay cut. Thoughts?

Owen: rebuild could be fast if it's just re-upload, but checksum mismatch suggests partial upload or S3 finalize race. Given 503s, I'd prefer pin to ensure cut. We can reopen artifact job and force reupload after infra stabilizes.

release-coordinator: product will accept pin if we add clear release note and timeline for reintroducing the change. They want contact and rollforward ETA.

Nina: consensus seems pin. Owen, can you open promo-pin PR and manual promote runbook? Also open infra ticket to investigate cache-pruner and S3 503 window.

Owen: creating promo-pin PR https://git.internal/repo/promo-pin/901. Manual promote runbook draft ready, will kick promote once PR merges. Infra ticket created https://infra.internal/tickets/1499 with S3 region logs attached.

deploy-bot: ACTION: promo pinned to v2026.5.20 (manual override) by Owen at 4412360120. Release window preserved.

Nina: thanks. Follow-ups: Owen to kick manual promote, infra to triage cache-pruner/S3 503s, CI to rebuild artifacts once infra stable and run a smoke canary before next cut. release-coordinator to publish release note: "Pinned to previous image due to transient artifact fetch failures; fix/retry planned." Closing thread.
